name: SAEE Evaluate Agent Run
description: Validate a SAEE rehearsal run and evaluate whether its exported candidate evidence satisfies the fixed AUTHORIZED_AGENT_ACTION adequacy profile.
when_to_use: A validated SAEE rehearsal run is available.
The caller needs claim-specific evidence adequacy and missing-requirement output.
The caller accepts that profile support is not task success or deployment approval.
when_not_to_use: To decide whether an Agent is safe.
To authorize deployment or an external action.
To evaluate arbitrary external traces that are not SAEE rehearsal runs.
recommended_next_pr: No code PR - human review of the Design Partner protocol is required before external action
